series.scope: Nikon-branded FX photography lenses, across mounts and product generations

collection.source_basis: United States patent publications, whose specifications are in the public domain. Each candidate is identified by publication number and example; the transcribed surface table is what is committed.
collection.redistribution: Public domain (US patent publications); the repository's MIT license covers the records.

hashing.source_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the rendered publication text the transcription was made from; the text is a reading of the publication on patents.google.com, recorded in docs/NIKON_FX_INTAKE.md
hashing.project_sha256: SHA-256 of the committed project.json bytes, UTF-8, LF, one trailing newline
hashing.record_hash: SHA-256 over the record's JSON with record_hash and record_hash_method removed: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8, no trailing newline
